informal_statement: The inverse cap-area angle is continuous at each positive input.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:283-291, the source contract is `lemma θOf_continuousAt {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : ContinuousAt θOf x`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
